basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Science, Patna (IGIMS), Bihar, has invited applications for the post of Senior Resident under Advt No. IGIMS/2026/Patho. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 10 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna (non-refundable).

qualification.education_qualification: MD Pathology; a medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of MCI; MCI recognized P.G. qualification of MD in the respective department; registration with Central/State Medical Council
qualification.details: Qualification: MD Pathology; A Medical Qualification as included in schedule I & II of MCI; MCI recognized P.G. Qualification of MD in respective department; The candidate must be registered with Central/State Medical Council Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on 30 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 05 years, EBC/BC 03 years, Female (all categories) 03 years, Physically Handicapped As per rule of Govt. of Bihar, Persons working in Govt. Institution As per rule | Other conditions: | Only Indian citizens may attend Must be registered with Central/State Medical Council Post is non-practising; private practice of any kind, including laboratory, is prohibited Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided Reservation benefit only for Bihar State domicile candidates

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 67700 NPA + usual allowance as admissible for Senior Resident in the Institute

how_to_apply: Download the application proforma from the Institute website www.igims.org.
Fill the prescribed proforma and attach copies of all supporting certificates and documents.
Prepare a non-refundable Demand Draft for the fee payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna.
Report by 10:00 AM on 10.12.2026 at the HOD, Pathology Chamber, IGIMS, Patna-14 with the form, fee and all original certificates.

content_sections.heading: IGIMS Senior Resident Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
Key Points
content_sections.text: Walk-in date: 10 December 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM Vacancies: 1 How to apply: Attend the walk-in interview Fee: UR/EWS/BC/EBC: Rs. 1000; SC/ST: Rs. 250 Pay: Rs. 67700 NPA + usual allowance as admissible for Senior Resident in the Institute Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on 30 November 2026) Place: Department of Pathology, IGIMS, Patna

content_sections.heading: IGIMS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. IGIMS/2026/Patho gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IGIMS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MD Pathology; A Medical Qualification as included in schedule I & II of MCI; MCI recognized P.G. Qualification of MD in respective department; The candidate must be registered with Central/State Medical Council Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on 30 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 05 years, EBC/BC 03 years, Female (all categories) 03 years, Physically Handicapped As per rule of Govt. of Bihar, Persons working in Govt. Institution As per rule Other conditions: Only Indian citizens may attend Must be registered with Central/State Medical Council Post is non-practising; private practice of any kind, including laboratory, is prohibited Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided Reservation benefit only for Bihar State domicile candidates

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Employed candidates without a No Objection Certificate from the employer will not be considered for selection Candidates from outside Bihar are not entitled to reservation Canvassing in any form is a disqualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Ad-hoc appointment for a period of 89 days till the full-time (3-year tenure) recruitment of Senior Resident is completed Appointment terminated if found doing private practice

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna (non-refundable).

content_sections.heading: How Will IGIMS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document verification on the same day before the interview Interview / assessment under a 100-mark scheme based on bio-data and interview MBBS 10 marks (-2 for each failure); MS/MD/DNB 10 marks (-5 for each failure) Additional qualification 10 marks; Publication 10 marks (PubMed 2 each up to 6, other 2 each up to 4) Poster/Presentation 10 marks; Academic Award 10 marks (2 each up to 10) Specialized training 10 marks (3 months: 2, 3-6 months: 5, over 6 months: 10); Project 10 marks Subject Knowledge 20 marks; total 100 marks Minimum qualifying: UR 50th percentile, BC/EBC/EWS 45th percentile, SC/ST 40th percentile

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form in the prescribed proforma with recent photograph affixed Demand Draft for the application fee payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna Copies and originals of certificates of age, qualifications (from MBBS), reservation and caste No Objection Certificate from employer if employed; written declaration if not employed or studying Caste certificate from Circle Officer of Bihar; creamy layer exemption certificate for EBC/BC; domicile certificate; EWS certificate Reprints of publications and certificates of presentations; experience certificates after MD/DNB

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application proforma from the Institute website www.igims.org. Fill the prescribed proforma and attach copies of all supporting certificates and documents. Prepare a non-refundable Demand Draft for the fee payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna. Report by 10:00 AM on 10.12.2026 at the HOD, Pathology Chamber, IGIMS, Patna-14 with the form, fee and all original certificates.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 December 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 10 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: HOD, Pathology Chamber, IGIMS, Patna.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR/EWS/BC/EBC: Rs. 1000. SC/ST: Rs. 250.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on 30 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 05 years, EBC/BC 03 years, Female (all categories) 03 years, Physically Handicapped As per rule of Govt. of Bihar, Persons working in Govt. Institution As per rule.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 67700 NPA + usual allowance as admissible for Senior Resident in the Institute.

faq.question: Q8. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MD Pathology; a medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of MCI; MCI recognized P.G. qualification of MD in the respective department; registration with Central/State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q9. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian citizens may attend. Must be registered with Central/State Medical Council. Post is non-practising; private practice of any kind, including laboratory, is prohibited. Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided.

faq.question: Q10. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Employed candidates without a No Objection Certificate from the employer will not be considered for selection. Candidates from outside Bihar are not entitled to reservation. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification.
